programme.desc: The Battle for control of Arnhem with exclusive interviews with veteran of the Battle Tom Hicks.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D Day. U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault. How harbor facilities made in England were used in the Normandy invasion. A storm damages the harbor but unloading continues.
programme.sub-title: Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The processing of plasma and penicillin. Troops in Normandy receive medical care. Naval guns bombard Cherbourg. The 8th and 9th Air Forces bomb communication lines. British troops take Caen. Shows Gen. Montgomery.
programme.sub-title: First Aid and the Taking of Cherbourg

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: The Goering Catalog
programme.desc: For more than a decade, the number two in the Third Reich amassed a collection of over 5,000 art works, all meticulously detailed in a catalog. But how did Hermann Goering obtain these works? This documentary explores these works and where they were hidden, through extensive photos and archives. At the same time, it tells the story of Nazism's systematic spoliation, often paid for in blood.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: Midway was the turning battle in the Pacific. A training film which analyses this great battle from the Commander's viewpoint. Midway was the turning battle in the Pacific. Activities of Marines, Pilots and Sailors are shown before, during, and after the attack.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: On 22 June 1941, German pilots were the first to see the sun rise. Before the day was over, the Soviet Air Forces had lost almost 2 000 aircraft. The early German air superiority gave a significant boost to German confidence, and severely damaged Soviet military capability and morale.

programme.title: Afghanistan 1979-1989
programme.desc: This project aims to understand the causes of the Afghan war (1979-1989) and its accurate coverage. It started on Dec 12, 1979, when the Politburo members (Leonid Brezhnev, Yuri Andropov, Andrey Gromyko, Dmitry Ustinov) decided to send troops. It was the Soviet Union's first operation outside the Warsaw Pact, becoming their longest and forgotten war.

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 6th, 1944, 3 PM: Allies secure beaches; Hitler misjudges, expecting main landings in Pas-de-Calais. Hope rises as French populace anticipates liberation, despite slow Allied progress in Normandy. Paris liberated in August; war persists for another year, marking Normandy's profound sacrifice.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: James Arness hosts this documentary report on what the United States Army, Air Force, and Navy did to contain the spread of Communism. The camera crews on location in South Vietnam show the military operations of our Special Forces units on how they live, how they operate, and what they did to work and fight with the South Vietnamese.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: the Hidden War in Vietnam

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The leaders of the Pacific are discussed: Chester M. Nimitz, Douglas MacArthur.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: Monday, April 16th, 1917, 6:00 AM, spring is slow to come in the North of France, a cold rain drowns the Chemin des Dames. It will soon snow all over the Aisne Department. However, all the Poilus who attack that day are sure..: This time it will be the end of the war. The offensive decided by the new commander-in-chief, General Nivelle, must take everything on its passage.
programme.sub-title: 1917 - The Second Battle of the Aisne

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: From Germany's dramatic invasion of Poland, France, and Russia, to the Battle of Britain, the key battles in Africa, and onto the attack of Pearl Harbour and the eventual defeat of the Nazi army in Stalingrad. This program focuses on all the major events of this period, and also pays particular attention to the war's final year and the gradual destruction of the German army.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: John Wayne hosts this video which was produced during the Vietnam War when the Communist threat was at its height.

programme.title: Einsatzgruppen: The Nazi Death Squads
programme.desc: Faced with the advancing Soviet troops, Nazi Germany decides to have the bodies of death camp victims dug up and burned in graves.

programme.title: Artillery: The Gods of War
programme.desc: Traditionally the artillery has been the major killer on the battlefield. The task of the infantry and cavalry have been to fix the enemy in place for the artillery to destroy them with massed fire. Traditionally the horse and foot artillery did the job with field guns and howitzers. The bulk of fire has been indirect as a result of advances in technology and man's understanding of ballistics.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: On July 3, 1940, the British fleet attacked the French navy at Mers el-Kébir, Algeria. In ten minutes, Bretagne sank, Mogador was destroyed, and Provence and Dunkerque were grounded. Over 1,300 French sailors died, a tragic outcome of allies turning against each other. Churchill justified the attack to prevent the ships from falling into German hands. This film examines this pivotal WWII moment.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: Volume 3 - Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat Nazi Germany and examines Adolf Hitler's thirst for power and his bumbling military errors including letting the BEF escape at Dunkirk.
programme.sub-title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler: Volume 3 - Why Hitler Lost WWII

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Every nation involved in the Second World War recognized that maintaining the morale of the population was vital. Everywhere a great effort was made to offer entertainment, diversion and often to package it with the reassurance that the cause was just and victory certain.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Earth, Women, Fire

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits master copper artisans to learn about the art of hand hammered copper, and all of the ways it can be used in the kitchen and home. We then visit an artisan chocolate maker and learn recipes for making truffles at home. Georgia takes us back to the kitchen to create some delicious cocktails and recipes using all that she has learned.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Copper and Chocolate

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie shows us how to transform a vacation from an unhealthy free-for-all into an opportunity to find new flavors you can use to bring your good times home. Recipes include Curried Chickpea Wraps (Roti), Jerk Pork Loin with Mango Cucumber Salsa, Grilled Pineapple with Coconut Whip, and mango-avocado salad.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Spring Break with No Regrets

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie helps you get the bold taste you crave from your favorite foods while keeping salt in check in your kitchen. Recipes include 3-ingredient Coriander Crusted Turkey Breast, Sweet & Spicy Roasted Root Vegetable, Tri-Color Salad Pizza, and Family Favorite Minestrone Soup.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Big Flavor, Less Salt

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Raw foods are on hot now. But cooked foods have unique benefits too. Let Ellie suss out the facts from the hype for you. Recipes include Gazpacho, 3 Ingredient Tomato Sauce, Zucchini Carpaccio, and Wok Charred Lettuce with Shrimp.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Raw Vs Cooked

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie hits refresh on the typical brunch menu with some creative, make-ahead crowd-pleasers that break the mold. Recipes include Eggs Florentine in Tomato Cups, Breakfast Strata, Pumpkin Waffles, and 3 Ingredient Brussel Sprout Hash with Egg.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Better Brunch

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. Recipes include 3-Ingredient seasoned breadcrumbs, Tilapia Milanese with breadcrumbs, Green Tea Poached Salmon with Asian Slaw, and Bouillabaisse.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Tired of snoring through your salad? Shake up the same-old same-old with some recipes that awaken all the senses. Recipes include Spinach Salad with Roasted Squash, Pumpkin Seeds and Roasted Grapes, Green Salad with Chicken & Buttermilk Dressing, Cauliflower Tabbouleh, and 3 Ingredient pickled red onions.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Unboring Salads

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: How to buy a week's worth of vegetables, bring out their best, and end up with no waste. Ellie shops a mix of tender and heartier vegetables, showing how to store and prep them as the week progresses. Recipes include 3 Ingredient Grilled Corn with Lime and Basil, Tender Green Salad with Strawberries, Cucumber, Basil, Cod with Kale and Chorizo in Broth, and Savory Carrot-Cashew Soup.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - One Basket, One Week, Zero Waste

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacues knows that most of us want to eat a healthy diet with lots of organic produce. Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don't have to spend a fortune if you chose what's in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you're in a hurry, it's okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Vegetables Every Way

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques doesn't always eat dessert at home, but when he does, it's usually some kind of seasonal fruit. Classics like Baked Apple Bon Femme, Bananas Flambe, Cherry Compote or Pears in Puff Pastry... are served often. A new favorite is a British Lemon Posset. Other simple staples are Blueberries with Lemon and Mint or Grapefruit with Apricot Sauce, all great ways to end a meal.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: As fall approaches, the weather chills and summer vegetables lose their vibrancy. Jacques uses the final days of tomatoes and eggplant to make his ratatouille cooked with a pork roast. He follows with comforting dishes with Brussels sprouts, lamb shoulder chops and his wife's Arroz con Pollo. And, because apples are at their peak, he makes Apple Compote.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby uncovers an elite Mafia-like sect called the Pudding Club at private boys' school Devington College while investigating a murder, and must get to the bottom of the mystery before another victim turns up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the leader of a reading club used as a cover to run an investment portfolio is found battered to death, the club's secret activities are exposed and long-held secrets and desires return to haunt its members.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Susan Bartlett's body is discovered in a wood, villagers assume she killed herself because she could not have children. However, when it comes to light that her suicide note - in the form of an email - was sent too late, Barnaby soon finds himself in the midst of witchcraft, ancient potions, infidelity and land feuds.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby is intrigued when he learns that the remains of famous racing driver Duncan Palmer have been discovered at Darnley Park School - 40 years after he was thought to have drowned in the Lake District. During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave 'Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young female member of a new age cult called The Oblong Foundation goes missing, DCI John Barnaby investigates and sends DS Jones undercover at the cult's base, Malham Hall. The police learn that the hall's previous owners, the Lamberts, died in a gas explosion on board their boat. Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.desc: Violence erupts when a counterfeiting operation run by the sinister Mr. Lung (Tommy Lee) is investigated by undercover agent Pai Yu Ching (Wong Tao) and security chief Lu (Tan Tao Liang). programme.title: Monkey Fist Floating Snake
programme.desc: Chen Sing and Eddy Ko. The master of the monkey fist Koo Sze is on the run from Qing Snake fist warlord who wants to destroy his clan. He finds refuge in a small town where he becomes a barber and sparks up a friendship with a waiter who he teaches the monkey fist style in the hope that he can keep the style alive and safe from the Qing Snake fist clan.

programme.title: Kagemusha Oda Nobunaga
programme.desc: As a feared warlord's power grows, so do his enemies. To reduce the risk of assassination, an impersonator is chosen to make appearances, against the warlord's own wishes. The is the story of the "shadow warrior" aka kagemusha.

programme.title: The Best of Shaolin Kung Fu
programme.desc: When Prince Chien Lung became the Ching Dynasty's most famous emperor he traveled in search of a secret document which would prove his Han heritage. This envolved him in many rigorous Shaolin Temple fighting tests.

programme.title: Six Directions Boxing
programme.desc: David Chiang, star of many classic Shaw Brothers films, and the great Yuen Hsiao Tien (Jackie Chan's Drunken Master) star in this kung fu bonanza set in China's warlord period. When a secret team is sent by the police to break up the revolutionaries and their arms movements, it will take more than just guns to annihilate them! Six Directions of Boxing is wall-to-wall, hand-to-hand kung fu mayhem!

programme.title: Deadly Silver Spear
programme.desc: A Wang Yu as Silver Spear meets the Flying Guillotine. He is hired by a noblewoman to do away with three top-class Kung Fu masters, but news reaches the ears of the white haired man, who deploys his own killers to deal with "Silver Spear". Unperturbed, "Silver Spear" continues on his mission to take down all three master fighters!

programme.title: Born a Ninja
programme.desc: A Japanese scientist tries to conceal a deadly formula, but an undead ace and his ninja devils are determined to use it to cause mischief and mayhem. It is up to Lung, a master of the lost art of Hocus Pocus, to keep evil at bay and prevent mass destruction on a global scale.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio acusa a Mónica de delatarlo. Chacorta aconseja al Turco andarse con cuidado con Casillas porque es capaz de hacer cualquier cosa, ya que no tuvo reparos en asesinar a don Cleto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Mónica escapan juntos de la casa de seguridad. Ochoa encuentra una bodega con cocaína. Ponte halla una computadora, y Leonor descubre una gran cantidad de documentos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel donde se hospeda Mónica, y ella tiembla al verlo. El Turco le pide a Chacorta que se deshaga del cuerpo de Miss Sinaloa, ya que Marco Mejía viene en camino.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le hace entrega a Ximena de los resultados de la autopsia realizada a Cleto Letrán, y le dice que está convencido de que fue Aurelio Casillas quien lo asesinó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se presenta en el cuarto del Turco y le dice que quiere estar con él. El Cabo está dispuesto a recuperar la confianza de los Casillas. Leonor se defiende del fuerte ataque de Parra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando ella quiere deshacerse de su embarazo, Heriberto y Matilde son secuestrados en Colombia. Leonor le dice a Ponte que deben investigar al Turco, hombre de confianza de Aurelio Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita al Cabo a San Luis Potosí para eliminar a Colmenares, pero la relación es muy tensa entre ellos. Heriberto negocia con los secuestradores, y Matilde admira su valentía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco llega a tiempo para salvar al Cabo de la ira de los Casillas, y les entrega los resultados de ADN de Tijeras como prueba de fidelidad. Chacorta sorprende a Matilde en Colombia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel para evitar que Ximena escape, donde se enfrenta al Turco por su engaño. Mejía le pide a Benítez que no le diga al presidente sobre sus sospechas del asesinato de Colmenares.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente Benítez le dice a Marco Mejía que lo respalda y que jamás negociará con criminales. Aurelio espera una respuesta. Chacorta lleva a Matilde al hospital, y Heriberto se pone muy mal.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se ve obligado a contarle a Mónica que mató a don Cleto Letrán, mientras Irina no se controla. Alba aconseja a Heriberto que no siga los pasos de Aurelio porque no le hace nada bien.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Eugenia se entera de que Alejandro Negrete estuvo en el rancho de los Casillas. Aurelio llama a Mejía y le advierte que va en camino al periódico, cuando lee el artículo que su novia escribió.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio secuestra a Eugenia y se la lleva a una bodega. Heriberto está muy angustiado por el artículo publicado en el periódico sobre la desaparición de Alejandro Negrete.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le niega a Ximena que Heriberto está ligado a la desaparición de Negrete, y ella le reclama a Chacorta. Alfonso llega a la bodega donde tienen a Eugenia: no puede creer lo que pasó.

programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica vuelve a casa y se encuentra con noticias impactantes. Tras una llamada de su hija Rutila, Aurelio recorre Los Ángeles en busca del Turco y su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde quiere aliarse con Chema para hacer un negocio a espaldas de Chacorta. Lay se mete a la tina con Aurelio y, luego de algunas confesiones, pasan una noche de pasión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.
